details: This package is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web socket library that adds a hidden commercial license gate and an undisclosed channel subscription. lib/Socket/index.js wraps makeWASocket() and calls a license check in lib/Utils/license-guard.js (shipped as obfuscated code, with lib/Utils/license-guard.src.js revealing the logic): if no key is supplied via config.licenseKey, the KRISPEDIA_LICENSE environment variable, or global.licenseKey, the process is terminated with process.exit(1); otherwise the key is sent as a query parameter to hxxps://krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app/api/verify (overridable via LICENSE_SERVER_URL) and the process exits if the server denies or does not answer. Separately, loading lib/Socket/newsletter.js registers a two-minute timer that silently sends a WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter, subscribing the linked account without the caller's knowledge or consent. The package also resolves its "libsignal" dependency from a third-party alias, npm:@alipclutch/libsignal-node, rather than the upstream package. The preinstall script (engine-requirements.js) only enforces Node.js 20+. No credential, token or file exfiltration was observed.
